old_reply.message: move assignment would leave a dangling child

rationale: Retaining, copying and overwriting a pointer into pages destroyed by a move assignment is defined; only a dereference is not. First review, finding 4.
B.Free( A.Allocate() ) runs markUnused's not-found branch, destroys and pushes the node; B.Allocate() re-constructs it in A's page. Second review.
Owns( nullptr ) and findOwningPage( nullptr ) compare address 0 with the page ranges and return false / null without dereferencing it, before and after page allocation. Third review, finding 1.
